title: What If the Whole World Went Vegetarian?

scenes.text: What if the entire world went vegetarian tomorrow? Oxford scientists actually ran the numbers.
Their 2016 study in PNAS found that food-related greenhouse gas emissions would drop by about sixty-three percent.
Go fully vegan and the cut grows to about seventy percent.
By 2050, a vegetarian world could avoid around seven million deaths a year linked to diet.
The researchers also estimated savings of seven hundred billion to a trillion dollars a year in healthcare and lost work.
And you don't need everyone: simply following global dietary guidelines would still cut emissions by about twenty-nine percent.
